tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Finds UK companies in the Companies Daily database by name or Companies House company number: name, company number, company type, status, town and region, url of the company card. The database holds the companies with a classified Companies House filing since 1 Nov 2026. Details and filing history:

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company by company number, as on its Companies Daily card: company type, status, incorporation and dissolution dates, town, postcode district and region of the registered office, jurisdiction, SIC codes, last accounts and the next accounts and confirmation statement due (with overdue flags), charg

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Classified Companies House filings of UK companies (administrations, liquidations, receiverships, voluntary arrangements, proposals to strike off, dissolutions, restorations, incorporations, director changes, registered office moves, capital, name and control changes, charges, accounts filed) filter

tools.name: get_daily_edition
tools.description: What changed at UK companies on one day of Companies House filings: companies by event type and the administrations, liquidations, receiverships, voluntary arrangements and restorations of the day. Without a date: the latest ready edition.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: Days with an edition, newest first: state (ready or open), companies with classified filings, new companies, administrations, liquidations, strike-off notices, dissolutions, director changes.

tools.name: get_region_summary
tools.description: Companies House filings of companies with a registered office in one UK region: event counts since the start of the data, the latest insolvencies, new companies, strike-offs and dissolutions, director changes, and towns with a page.

tools.name: list_event_types
tools.description: Values for the filters: 17 event types (key, list slug, label, url of the list) and the 12 UK regions (slug, name, url).
